annotation.title_clean: Schichtarbeit: Eine Orientierungshilfe für die Prävention (DGUV Information 206-024)
annotation.title_en: Shift Work: A Guidance for Prevention (DGUV Information 206-024)
annotation.summary_en: German statutory accident insurance guidance (June 2025) on preventive, health-oriented design of shift and night work, covering accident risks, circadian rhythms, risk assessment, occupational health care, special groups, an ergonomic checklist and legal bases. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Shift work should be included in the workplace risk assessment, with attention to psychosocial strain.
Forward-rotating shifts, at most 2-3 consecutive night shifts, and shifts of no more than 8 hours are recommended.
Minimum 11 hours rest between shifts, as legally required.
Night workers are entitled to occupational health examinations every three years, annually after age 50.
Special attention is advised for pregnant women, minors, people with disabilities and older workers.
